title: The Night Visitor at the Museum
intro: Someone keeps slipping into the museum after closing time, and the night guard has noticed small things moved around in the morning.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: I was sketching the armor in the castle room, all night.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Ancient pottery is my calling. Nothing else, ever.

suspects.name: Marcy
suspects.line: I only came to see the dinosaur bones. Lovely bones.

suspects.name: Otto
suspects.line: I was in the gift shop counting postcards, very carefully.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: The night guard waved at me. He can vouch for that.

clues.text: The security log shows the culprit was never near the pottery room that night, so that room can be crossed off the list.
A pair of round glasses was left hanging on the coat rack, a clue that the culprit wore round glasses that evening.
A receipt-sized note was found by the register: the culprit was last seen heading into the gift shop after closing time.
The red scarf hanging here was checked against the footage, and the culprit was not wearing a red scarf, so it can be ruled out.
